bear.reason: Secular case: GenAI substitution bites Insights (78% of revenue); revenue declines over several years; margin holds above the COVID trough (FY2020 12.0%) on subscription cost flex; the multiple sits near the low end of its own nine-year trading range (7.46x), with 9.5x at roughly the 5th percentile. [restated for external readability 2026-07-21; substance unchanged]

base.reason: Margin is the seven-year clean median of 18.45% (rounded to 18.5%), excluding the $150M FY25 goodwill impairment. The 14.13% full-history screening median is dragged down by the pre-2021 regime, while the last five years ran 18-21%. Revenue is consensus FY26E. The multiple is set deliberately below the 23.4x median of that nine-year trading range: a decelerating top line does not re-earn the growth-era multiple. [restated for external readability 2026-07-21; substance unchanged]

bull.reason: The turn proves cyclical: FY27E re-acceleration (+4%); margin near the FY2023 best (20.94%); the multiple moves toward but stays below the median of its own trading history. [restated for external readability 2026-07-21; substance unchanged]

revenue.method: Legs are set off the recorded consensus path rather than round numbers: base is consensus FY26E, bull is consensus FY27E (the modelled re-acceleration), and bear takes a multi-year secular decline materially below FY26E to price the GenAI-substitution case. verdict.rationale: BUY at 141.06. Underwrite PASS 7.04:1 at 140.19 (2026-07-17); re-verified 6.69:1 at entry. Stress: brutal secular bear (rev −20%, margin 13%, 8x → $75.24) still clears 2.02:1 — barely, against the 2.0 bar. Known fragility, accepted: fails only if base multiple compresses to ~12x alongside the secular bear — i.e. only if revenue never re-stabilizes. Side taken: overshoot over GenAI disruption — five consecutive years of 18–21% operating margins, absolute EBITDA rising through the de-rate, LTM FCF +$1,064M (~11% FCF yield at spot), priced at ~the 3rd percentile of its own 9.3-year multiple band. Market prices structural decline; committed evidence shows revenue deceleration with an intact earnings base.
reunderwrite_triggers: Q2-2026 print (early Aug): contract-value growth decelerates further or turns negative -> deepen the bear case and re-underwrite. [restated for external readability 2026-07-21; substance unchanged]
revenue below the FY26E consensus path two consecutive quarters → re-test base at 12x
operating margin breaks below ~16% ex one-offs → regime assumption fails
verdict.rationale_plain: BUY at $141.06, 6.7:1 against the 2:1 bar; a brutal secular bear still clears 2.0. The market is pricing GenAI as a structural displacement of syndicated research; our judgment is that the sell-off has overshot fair value for a still-intact business — five straight years of 18–21% operating margins, absolute EBITDA rising through the decline, ~11% trailing free-cash-flow yield, an entry near the 3rd percentile of its own nine-year multiple range. Only the top line has slowed. The trade fails if revenue never re-stabilizes — a shrinking Gartner deserving ~12x — with contract-value growth at the August print as the first test.
